basic_information.recipe_name: Continuous Pad-Steam Vat Dyeing of 100% Cotton Woven Bottoms

dye_information.dye_name: Vat Olive Green (10 g/L) + Vat Brown 1 (5 g/L) + Vat Yellow 2 (3 g/L)

chemical_information.chemical_function: Chemical Reduction Pad liquor; converts insoluble vat pigment to soluble leuco form inside steamer
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Prepared in chemical padder trough continuously metered
chemical_information.compatibility: Must be maintained under strict reducing conditions

chemical_information.chemical_function: Prevents vat dye pigment migration during intermediate drying phase
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Added directly to dye pigment pad liquor

chemical_information.chemical_function: Oxidation bath; re-oxidizes soluble leuco vat dye back to insoluble pigment inside fiber
chemical_information.addition_sequence: Dosed in 1st wash box after steaming at 60°C

process_parameters.temperature_profile: Pad Pigment @ 25°C -> IR Pre-dry -> Hot Air Dry @ 110°C -> Chemical Pad @ 25°C -> Steamer @ 102°C (45s) -> Oxidation @ 60°C -> Soap @ 95°C
process_parameters.time: Fabric Speed: 40 m/min | Steamer Dwell Time: 45 seconds
process_parameters.ph: Reduction Steaming pH: 13.0 | Oxidation pH: 4.5 - 5.5 | Final Wash pH: 6.5
process_parameters.pressure: Pad Mangle Nip Pressure: 3.5 bar | Steamer Pressure: Atmospheric (Positively sealed)

process_steps.pretreatment: Singed, enzymatic desized, continuous bleached & mercerized woven canvas
process_steps.dye_addition: Pad dye pigment liquor at 65% wet pick-up $\rightarrow$ Pass through IR pre-dryer
process_steps.salt_addition: Glauber's salt (20 g/L) added to chemical reduction pad bath to suppress dye stripping
process_steps.alkali_addition: Caustic Soda (45 mL/L) continuously fed to chemical pad trough
process_steps.washing: Cold water overflow rinse immediately exiting steamer
process_steps.soaping: Oxidize with H2O2 at 60°C $\rightarrow$ Hot soaping at 95°C in continuous 4-chamber washer
process_steps.neutralization: Final wash box neutralization with Acetic Acid
process_steps.drying: Continuous steam can dryer stack (24 cylinders @ 3.0 bar steam)
process_steps.finishing: Apply Water-repellent / Sanforized anti-shrinkage mechanical finishing

quality_parameters.rub_fastness: Dry Rubbing: Grade 4-5 | Wet Rubbing: Grade 4
quality_parameters.light_fastness: Grade 7-8 (Maximum light fastness for military spec)
quality_parameters.uniformity: Zero center-to-selvedge or head-to-tail shade variation

defects.common_defects: Tailing (Shade lighter at end of roll), Side-to-Center Shade Variation, Oxidation Specks
defects.causes: High pad trough volume (>25L), non-uniform pad mangle crown nip pressure, oxygen ingress in steamer
defects.corrective_actions: Install trough displacement wedge (renewal time <30s); adjust swimming roller pneumatic profile; seal steamer water locks

safety.ppe_required: Full face shield, heavy butyl rubber aprons, chemical resistant boots, respirator
safety.hazardous_chemicals: Concentrated Caustic Soda 38°Bé, Sodium Hydrosulfite, Hydrogen Peroxide 35%
safety.safety_precautions: Continuous toxic gas monitoring for sulfur dioxide (SO2) near steamer exit

references.notes: Vat dyes provide unmatched chlorine bleach fastness and weathering resistance
